title: Hex Bubble Dragon
description: Aim, bounce bank shots off the walls, and pop dazzling hexagonal clusters of crystal bubbles with your trusty little dragon launcher.
controls: Drag to aim your dotted trajectory line (bank off side walls for trick shots) and release to launch colorful hex bubbles.

zh-CN.title: 泡泡六角龙
zh-CN.description: 经典泡泡龙全面升级：拉线瞄准反弹发射六角晶莹泡泡，连爆三消引发整片雪崩掉落，轻松冲刺高分纪录。
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕拖动虚线瞄准发射角度（支持墙壁反弹），松手射出同色泡泡凑齐三个以上即可消除。
